items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Cantrell was the snare drum player with the Excelsis... Every time he'd, he'd give me the signal with that, with his stick that made me know how to hit that drum.

ctx.x: Of course, they went to New York. They had a couple of records that day, and they came on back and just stopped playing that, uh, out at Tranchinas, out at the lake. And they used, uh, broadcast every day on the, on the radio. Well, they had, that time they had, they had Peter, Cantrell playing drum, Laurie Warnick playing saxophone, Henry playing bass tuba, Charlie was playing Berenville. Mm-hmm.

What radio station, go ahead. Let's talk to you a while, let's see if it's working. It only took us twenty seconds, uh, then to, we cleaned the machine. We just cleaned it, so, uh. Oh, I see. Yeah, what radio station were they on? Huh? What radio station were they on? You say Pete was on the radio?
